profile.headline: Engineering @ Pinecone
profile.summary:
Hands-on engineering leader with 20+ years of experience building large-scale, customer-facing data systems at Pinecone, ServiceNow, Sony PlayStation, and others. Deep technical background in cloud-native infrastructure, AI/ML systems, and system and API design. Track record of building high-trust teams and driving measurable business outcomes.



Currently Director of Engineering at Pinecone, leading the Knowledge Engine and Experience Platform teams.

positions.title: Director / Sr Director Software Engineering
positions.description: Lead 12 engineers across two teams. The Experience Platform team owns the primary surface through which all Pinecone customers interact with the product: APIs, CLI, SDKs, MCP integrations, and the web console. The Knowledge Engine team is building a new advanced agentic knowledge retrieval system.

positions.title: Staff Engineer / Manager Software Engineering
positions.description: Wrote the initial implementation of the inference model hosting service and built a team around it. Owned the full stack end to end: API design, cloud-native Rust services on Kubernetes, CI/CD, usage metering, rate limiting, monitoring, and COGS management. Grew inference service token usage 34x year-over-year after establishing early usage levels. Implemented integrated inference APIs that simplified adoption and drove core database revenue.

positions.title: AI/Engineering Advisor
positions.description: Advising on AI, architecture, team, and product.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Databases · Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · Git · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Architecture · Docker Products · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · NoSQL · Linux

positions.title: CTO & Co-Founder
positions.description: Co-founded a B2B AI startup. Built and shipped multiple MVPs including an event-driven notification system (Twitter/Discord integrations), a data and analytics processing framework, and an AI-powered chatbot framework using LangChain, OpenAI, and Pinecone vector search.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Databases · Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · Git · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Architecture · Docker Products · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · NoSQL · Linux

positions.title: Director / Sr Director, Software Engineering - IoT / Connected Operations
positions.description: Served as Head of Engineering and Chief Architect for a startup-like team bootstrapping a new product offering in the IoT space. Designed a new architecture for processing high volume streaming IoT data utilizing public cloud shared services and integrated with the ServiceNow platform. Pitched and defended the architecture with stakeholders up to CTO and CPO levels, overcoming significant internal resistance. Built the MVP and validated with multiple early-access design partners. Scaled the team from 3 to 15 engineers, recruiting top talent and building a high-trust team culture.

positions.title: Manager / Sr. Manager, Software Engineering - Platform APIs and Authentication
positions.description: Led the teams that owned the all integration avenues in ServiceNow: inbound & outbound web services, bulk data import/export, and platform authentication.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Key contributor in developing the foundational REST API framework on top of the ServiceNow platform enabling internal development teams, partners, and customers to easily build their own domain-specific APIs using simple declarations and well-defined APIs for working with the HTTP request. Served as the basis for a complete UI overhaul on top of REST APIs defined in the new framework.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed an OAuth 2.0 compliant service provider for the Sony Entertainment Network used as the primary authentication/authorization mechanism for the new PS4 console. Designed and implemented an Account caching mechanism using Cassandra in order to remain “up” for normal console operations during full platform maintenance windows -- addressing a common customer complaint.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Java · Databases · REST APIs · Git · Mockito · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Architecture · NoSQL · Linux

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the UI engineering team on a common UAV ground station project. System design based on SOA concepts and implemented on the Java EE stack, including stateless EJB3 beans exposed as web services, and JMS messaging flows. Built rich thick-client applications for mission management, situational awareness, and payload operations user interfaces. Coordinated UI development with architecture teams and other software development teams to deliver an extensible, scalable and complete UAV ground station solution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented significant enhancements to a service-based distributed data library. Services were implemented in C++ and communicated via CORBA protocols.
Regularly supported on-site mission critical upgrade and test events. Performed advanced troubleshooting and technical investigation into system performance, discrepancy, etc.
